hotels.title: Once-in-a-Lifetime Great Barrier Reef Overwater Adventure with All-Inclusive Dining & Free-Flow Drinks
hotels.description: Experience one of the world’s most stunning natural wonders and glamp under the stars, on the waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Enjoy all-inclusive dining and drinks as you watch the sunset over the glittering Coral Sea from your overwater retreat, a once-in-a-lifetime stay. Enjoy a scenic roundtrip Whitsundays cruise to the newly-refurbished pontoon via Airlie Beach, Hamilton Island and Daydream Island, and experience a sensational sunset with the reef all to yourselves. This unmissable two-day, one-night adventure includes an overnight stay in a brand-new Reefbed on the top deck, where you can marvel at the galaxy of twinkling stars above and let the gentle waves lull you to sleep. Whether travelling solo or sharing the moment with someone special, this bucket-list experience is bound to leave you breathless.
